user.description:
1) **Right-click and copy** the link below, paste it into a private/incognito window that already has the developer tools (Network tab) open, and log in with your CLUB Panasonic ID: [Login link]({auth_url})
2) After login, paste the full callback?code=... URL shown in red in the Network tab (or just the code value) below. The code expires after about a minute.
3) Enter the x-api-key that the app sends with its requests.

error.auth: Login failed (the code may have expired). Open the login link again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Check the x-api-key and the code.
